what_happened: Scene: layout 5, black CoffeeMachine042 (two cup-icon buttons on the upper front, two nozzles), round blue mug_7 on the upper shelf. Stage 0: grasp 114/125 on the rim, mug carried down to the tray and under the nozzles by ~309, released 351 at 0.012 m (0.012 m 2 s later), upright (tilt max 33 deg while being carried). The gripper opened deliberately (0.013 -> 0.043 -> 0.077). Stage 1: it rose and came over the top of the machine to the cup-icon button face (420-540, wrist shows the buttons from above-right), touched the button at 543 (on), and backed off; stage 0 complete 560, success 563. Fast, clean episode: stage 0 560 steps (median 506), stage 1 3 steps after stage 0 (the press preceded the retreat).
official_criterion_notes: Stage 0 'first_complete' 560 lags the release (351) by 209 steps because the gripper stayed within 25 cm of the mug while going to the button.
